_doc: Labelled urgency corpus for AlertEvaluator (DAN-164). kind: message | feed. expected: immediate | routine. Names are fictional.

cases.text: Hi, Leo came to the nurse's office with a fever. Please come pick him up.
Leo is sick, please pick him up.
Isabella threw up after lunch and is resting in the health office.
Leo got hurt on the playground and we put an ice pack on his knee.
Please call me as soon as possible regarding an incident in class today.
Isabella is having an allergic reaction. We gave her the epi-pen and called 911.
No fever, but she vomited twice and is pale. Can someone come get her?
Don't panic, but Leo bumped his head on the slide and the nurse is checking for a concussion.
Early dismissal today at 12:30 because of a power outage.
Bus 12 is delayed by 40 minutes this afternoon.
After-school is cancelled today, please arrange pickup by 3:00.
We are in a lockdown. All students are safe; please do not come to the building.
Urgent: please call the office about Isabella's pickup.
I need to speak with you today about Leo. Please call me when you can.
Reminder: you are listed as the emergency contact. Leo has a fever and needs to be picked up right now.
Isabella fell at recess and may need stitches. Please come to school.
Leo was sent to the nurse with a bloody nose. He's okay but please call me.
She isn't hurt badly, but she hit her head and we'd like you to come pick her up.
Please bring Isabella's inhaler asap, she is wheezing.
Leo needs his inhaler. He is in the nurse's office with an asthma flare.
This is urgent. Please contact us immediately.
Reminder: please keep your child home if they are sick.
Please send in allergy-friendly snacks for Friday's party.
Nothing urgent, just a quick note that Isabella had a great day.
No one was hurt during today's fire drill. Great job, everyone!
Students must be fever-free for 24 hours before returning to school.
It's cold and flu season, so we are practicing washing our hands and covering coughs.
Please let us know of any food allergies before the class cooking project.
Our classroom is a nut-free zone. Thank you for checking labels!
Vision and hearing screenings with the school nurse are on Tuesday.
The flu shot clinic is Thursday in the gym; forms are in backpacks.
Ms. Alonso is out sick today; a substitute will cover the class.
We talked about how words can hurt feelings and practiced kind words.
Please return the field trip permission slip asap.
Picture day order forms are urgent; they are due Friday.
Nobody was sick this week, so we earned a class reward!
If your child has an inhaler or epi-pen, please make sure the nurse has a current form.
There is no early dismissal today; regular pickup at 3:15.
The nurse will be out on Friday; the front office can help with ice packs.
Isabella did awesome in reading group today! Homework is reading 15 minutes tonight.
Our policy: students who vomit or have a fever must go home.
Book fair money is due asap if you want to preorder.
Bus 12 is delayed by 30 minutes today due to road work.
Weather closure: school closing early at noon today.
Several students went home with fever today; there is a stomach bug outbreak.
Friday is pajama day! Wear your coziest PJs.
